Script.name: msleep_main
Script.script:
-- Ported by gizmmo local MSLEEP_SAVE_FILE = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/persistence/msleep_settings.lua"
local function msleepSaveSettings() table.save(MSLEEP_SAVE_FILE, { enabled = MSLEEP.enabled, campMode = MSLEEP.campMode, avoidPk = MSLEEP.avoidPk, }) end
if not MSLEEP then MSLEEP = { enabled = true, campMode = "off", avoidPk = true, autoSleep = false, wakeDeferred = false, tickTimerId = nil, tickHandlerId = nil, } local _saved = {} if pcall(function() table.load(MSLEEP_SAVE_FILE, _saved) end) then if _saved.enabled ~= nil then MSLEEP.enabled = _saved.enabled end if _saved.campMode ~= nil then MSLEEP.campMode = _saved.campMode end if _saved.avoidPk ~= nil then MSLEEP.avoidPk = _saved.avoidPk end end end
local function msleepEcho(msg) cecho(string.format("<green>[msleep]<reset> %s\n", msg)) end
local function gmcpNumber(path) local value = gmcp for key in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end value = value[key] end return tonumber(value) end
local function underThreshold(currentPath, maxPath, threshold) local c = gmcpNumber(currentPath) local m = gmcpNumber(maxPath) if not c or not m or m <= 0 then return false end return (c / m) < threshold end
local function getState() return tonumber(gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status and gmcp.char.status.state) end
local function canSendSleep() local state = getState() if not state then return false end if state ~= 3 and state ~= 11 then return false end -- active or resting/sitting
local pos = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status and gmcp.char.status.pos if pos == "Sleeping" then return false end
return true end
local function tryWakeFromAutoSleep() if not MSLEEP.autoSleep then return end
local state = getState() local pos = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status and gmcp.char.status.pos
if state == 8 then MSLEEP.wakeDeferred = true return end
if state == 9 or pos == "Sleeping" then send("wake", false) MSLEEP.autoSleep = false MSLEEP.wakeDeferred = false return end
-- If we're no longer sleeping (or sleep never landed), clear pending wake. MSLEEP.autoSleep = false MSLEEP.wakeDeferred = false end
local function inPkRoom() local details = gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info and gmcp.room.info.details if type(details) == "table" then for _, item in ipairs(details) do if type(item) == "string" and item:lower() == "pk" then return true end end elseif type(details) == "string" then return details:lower():find("pk", 1, true) ~= nil end return false end
function MSLEEP.toggle() MSLEEP.enabled = not MSLEEP.enabled msleepEcho(MSLEEP.enabled and "tick sleeping is on" or "tick sleeping is off") msleepSaveSettings() end
function MSLEEP.toggleCamp() if MSLEEP.campMode == "camp" then MSLEEP.campMode = "off" msleepEcho("auto camp is off") else MSLEEP.campMode = "camp" msleepEcho("auto camp is on") end msleepSaveSettings() end
function MSLEEP.toggleFire() if MSLEEP.campMode == "fire" then MSLEEP.campMode = "off" msleepEcho("auto fire is off") else MSLEEP.campMode = "fire" msleepEcho("auto fire is on") end msleepSaveSettings() end
function MSLEEP.togglePk() MSLEEP.avoidPk = not MSLEEP.avoidPk if MSLEEP.avoidPk then msleepEcho("tick sleeping will no longer occur in PK rooms") else msleepEcho("tick sleeping will now occur in PK rooms") end msleepSaveSettings() end
function MSLEEP.help() cecho("<green>[msleep] commands<reset>\n") cecho(" <white>ts<reset> - toggle auto tick sleeping on/off\n") cecho(" <white>ts camp<reset> - toggle sending 'camp' before sleeping\n") cecho(" <white>ts fire<reset> - toggle sending 'fire' before sleeping\n") cecho(" <white>ts pk<reset> - toggle whether to sleep in PK rooms\n") cecho(" <white>ts help<reset> - show this help\n") cecho("<green>sleeps 2s before tick when hp<70%%, mana<60%%, or moves<60%%<reset>\n") end
function MSLEEP.processTickWindow() if not MSLEEP.enabled then return end if MSLEEP.autoSleep then return end
local shouldSleep = underThreshold("char.vitals.hp", "char.maxstats.maxhp", 0.70) or underThreshold("char.vitals.mana", "char.maxstats.maxmana", 0.60) or underThreshold("char.vitals.moves", "char.maxstats.maxmoves", 0.60)
if not shouldSleep then return end if not canSendSleep() then return end
if MSLEEP.avoidPk and inPkRoom() then msleepEcho("you have chosen not to automatically sleep in PK rooms") return end
local roomNum = gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info and tostring(gmcp.room.info.num or "") if roomNum ~= "-1" then if MSLEEP.campMode == "camp" then send("camp", false) end if MSLEEP.campMode == "fire" then send("fire", false) end end
cecho("<green>2 seconds until tick<reset>\n") send("sleep", false) MSLEEP.autoSleep = true MSLEEP.wakeDeferred = false end
function MSLEEP.schedulePretickWindow() if MSLEEP.tickTimerId then killTimer(MSLEEP.tickTimerId) MSLEEP.tickTimerId = nil end
MSLEEP.tickTimerId = tempTimer(28, function() MSLEEP.tickTimerId = nil if MSLEEP and MSLEEP.processTickWindow then MSLEEP.processTickWindow() end end) end
function MSLEEP.onServerTick() tryWakeFromAutoSleep() MSLEEP.schedulePretickWindow() end
function MSLEEP.bootstrap() if MSLEEP.tickHandlerId then killAnonymousEventHandler(MSLEEP.tickHandlerId) MSLEEP.tickHandlerId = nil end
MSLEEP.tickHandlerId = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.comm.tick", function() if MSLEEP and MSLEEP.onServerTick then MSLEEP.onServerTick() end end) end
MSLEEP.bootstrap()
